notes:
Lead: Convo Pulse (B2B SaaS - in-app chat assistant). Inbound from self-serve signup. Small engineering team; rapid prototyping. Primary ask: low-latency streaming for a typing/assistant experience inside their web app.

Key details:
- Workload: conversational assistant for customer support + contextual suggestions; streaming responses for typing feel.
- Latency targets: prefer sub-200ms per message startup; acceptable up to 300ms initially but will push for <200ms at scale.
- Throughput: initial active users ~500, concurrent sessions expected 20-50 during peak; scaling plan for 1k+ users in Q3.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; looking to start on Hosted API (self-serve) and evaluate economics. Preference for open/quantized models if cost helps.
- Model preferences: open models (Llama2/Mistral family) + quantized variants; wants ability to fallback to cheaper model for non-critical responses.
- Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), audit logging, and retention controls. No on-prem requirement now — public cloud only.

What we covered on call:
- Demo of streaming endpoint and how to wire SDK into their chat component.
- Discussed batching & caching tradeoffs vs latency. Recommended trying low-latency config (min-batch) and prefix caching for repeated system prompt.
- Walked through pricing deck; they flagged token cost for high-frequency short messages as a blocker.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "Need a typing/streaming feel — if responses don't start right away users notice. Sub-200ms is ideal."
- "We want something that just works out of the box for now — hosted API first, but we may need dedicated capacity later if volume grows."

Next steps (short):
- AE (Ava) to schedule 60m technical deep-dive w/ engineering (target week of 2026-03-03).
- SE (Diego) to provide a dev sandbox + sample streaming integration repo and a low-latency config checklist by 2026-03-02.
- Customer to run 1-day perf test and share logs; SE to help interpret.

Blockers:
- SSO (SAML) not yet set up — demo access limited until SSO configured for broader team.
- Cost approval: finance needs a 1-page TCO vs current cloud LLM baseline.
- Need to validate model latency at their front-end network conditions (they have users in NA/EU).
